description: This header file declares the CacCapabilitiesDatabase class, which implements the CacCapabilities interface by reading and transforming values from the AgentDB. It provides methods to retrieve country code, CAC radios, supported CAC methods, CAC completion durations, and CAC operating classes, all related to CAC capabilities management in the beerocks namespace.

classes.name: CacCapabilitiesDatabase
classes.description: Implements the CacCapabilities interface, reading data from AgentDB to provide CAC capabilities information.

methods.name: CacCapabilitiesDatabase
methods.description: Default constructor for the CacCapabilitiesDatabase class.

methods.name: get_country_code
methods.description: Returns the country code associated with CAC capabilities.

methods.name: get_cac_radios
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MAC addresses for radios supporting CAC.

methods.name: is_cac_method_supported
methods.description: Checks if a specific CAC method is supported on a given radio MAC address.

methods.name: get_cac_completion_duration
methods.description: Returns the duration for CAC completion on a specified radio and method.

methods.name: get_cac_operating_classes
methods.description: Retrieves the CAC operating classes for a specified radio and method.
